name: What steps are involved in repairing a damaged mobile home subfloor?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in repairing a damaged mobile home subfloor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a mobile home floor involves inspecting the damage, removing the finish floor, replacing bad subflooring, and installing new flooring. First, the damaged area is cut back to the nearest structural joists. If leaks caused the issue, any underlying plumbing or joist damage must be resolved before proceeding. New subflooring panels are fitted, glued, and screwed into place to ensure a level surface. Finally, your chosen finish material—such as luxury vinyl plank or tile—is laid down. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra leads on-site carpentry work while managing any associated sub-trade repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves exposing joists, cutting out damaged particle board, reinforcing framing, securing new subflooring, and installing finish flooring.
